title: Rav Chaviva son of Rav Yosef son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Bava Batra 143b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.143b.9), he spoke in the name of Rava. Hyman identifies Nanai, mentioned in [Yevamot 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.66b.9), as his brother.[^1]

notes.text: Both passages give the full patronymic “son of Rav Yosef son of Rava.” [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1173&lang=en) also records Chaviva’s transmission from Rava. The brother relationship is Hyman’s inference.
